fields.sortOrderHint: Lower numbers come first in the POS.
fields.usesUnitsHint: Each variant then has a size (for example Medium or Large).

menu.draft: No variants yet: not in the POS
menu.draftHint: This product has no variants yet, so it is not shown in the POS. Add a variant in the Variants tab.
menu.structureLocked: Sizes and options can't change once the product has variants. Its variants keep them.

deleteBody.categories: The category leaves the menu and the POS. Past orders keep it. This can't be undone from the POS.
deleteBody.products: The product and its variants leave the menu and the POS. Past orders keep them, with the prices they were charged. This can't be undone from the POS.
deleteBody.variants: This variant leaves the POS. Past orders keep it, with the price it was charged. If it is the product's last variant, the product leaves the POS until a new one is added.
deleteBody.addons: The add-on is no longer offered on any product. Past orders keep it, with the price it was charged. This can't be undone from the POS.

menu.addOnNoProducts: Not offered on any product yet.
menu.addOnPricesHint: After saving, open the add-on to set its price on each product.
